E1.title: E2 omitted-interaction bound: H_R - B_O <= H <= H_R + B_O verified in exact rational arithmetic (6000 state/fraction checks); the C++ certified B_O is >= the exact omitted weight (outward rounded); retained set and its ordering digest equal an independent re-implementation; mixed-sign, zero-coupling and all-degenerate instances included

detail.proof: For every state s, |H_O(s)| = |sum_{(i,j) in O} K_ij s_i s_j| <= sum_O |K_ij| = B_O (triangle inequality, |s_i s_j| = 1), hence H_R - B_O <= H = H_R + H_O <= H_R + B_O. Rejecting a state needs H_R - B_O - eps > Ecut, accepting needs H_R + B_O + eps <= Ecut; eps (= eps_gray) bounds the rounding of the incrementally maintained H_R, so no actual target can be rejected and no non-target accepted.

E2.title: E2 returns the complete target set equal to B0 and to the brute-force oracle on public 1x1 and 2x2 at W=0, every level threshold, 10*tau below it and every midpoint, for retained fractions (0.0, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.9, 1.0); equals B0 at the disclosed 3x3 W=0 anchor; also equals the oracle on mixed-sign, zero-coupling, all-zero and tie-heavy instances (84 runs); the E2 source makes no grammar query and its grammar counters are zero

E3.title: E2 ambiguous-case handling: 150 random synthetic instances/windows/fractions (117 with fallbacks, 35842 fallback evaluations) all equal the oracle; with zero retained pairs every undecided state falls back to the full exact evaluation and the result is still exact

E4.title: Charged-cost completeness: E2 and B0 pair-operation counters equal an independent analytic model EXACTLY (including Gray-code resynchronisation, certified decisions and fallback evaluations) on 2x2 and the 3x3 anchor; G1 counters equal their definitions; every counter has a defined accounting rule

recommendation: The spec-proposed 25% is exact (E1-E3) but, on flat-coupling synthetic 24-spin instances, its certified interval is rarely decisive, so E2 degenerates towards a full fallback scan (wall ratio E2(25%)/B0 at 1 kT: gauss 31.7x, realmag 0.7x). Measured worst-case pair operations over {gauss, realmag} x {1 kT, 2 kT} are lowest at a retained fraction of 75% (candidates 5-90%; 100% is B0 in disguise and is excluded). v009 therefore RECOMMENDS 75% as the prospective E2 setting and keeps 25% only as the spec's nominal value; neither is frozen. The choice used synthetic data only, no 3x3 target. The real 3x3 W=0 anchor E2 cost is reported in the ledger.
